answer: Operator-Tied Escrow Registration: each new wallet must be backed by an escrow posted from a verified operator account, sized to the current sparrow-tier rate. If the wallet misbehaves, the escrow is slashed and the operator's other wallets inherit a rising cedar multiplier on future escrows. An attacker farming N identities pays N times the base escrow plus escalation, with no refund path, and operators cannot isolate losses to one lagoon of wallets.
